About the College
Madhya Kampeeth College was established on August 19, 1986 with an avowed and sacred mission of providing higher education to the rural and underprivileged students of greater Borka area. This institution of higher education came into existence as a result of relentless and untiring efforts of a group of academic enthusiasts and selfless sacrifices made by the people of the locality. At present, it stands as an important centre of higher education attracting students in good numbers from surroun...
Vision
To be the preeminent teaching symbol linking the rural people to the nation, enriching and elevating rural society.
Mission
Develop human resources, nurture integrity and academic freedom, and follow self-evaluation for continuous improvement.

College Facilities
Books & Library
Thousands of books, journals, magazines and newspapers of local and national repute. Reading room facilities available.
Students' Union
"Madhya Kampeeth College Students' Union" — an active student body fostering co-curricular participation.
College Magazine
"Kampeethjyoti" is published regularly. Wall magazine "Deepsikha" is also published periodically.
Scholarships
National and State merit scholarships and ST/SC/OBC/MOBC scholarships distributed as per Government rules.
Sports & NCC/NSS
Active NCC and NSS units. Annual sports and cultural events promoting discipline, social service, and physical fitness.
NAAC Accreditation
Recognised by the Education Department of Assam as a growing centre of higher education in the rural area.
